answer: The relic schedule is applied in inlet and garden makes public each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 50% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2736 identities would post 3010 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
